type:
∀ (x : Rocq.Corelib.Init.Number.uint),
  NativeBridge.Incremental.numberUintTo x =
    Rocq.Corelib.Init.Number.uint.rec (fun ds => Sum.inl (NativeBridge.decimalDigitsTo ds))
      (fun ds => Sum.inr (NativeBridge.hexadecimalDigitsTo ds)) x
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.numberUintTo.eq_1

type:
∀ (ds : Rocq.Corelib.Init.Number.uint),
  NativeBridge.natTo (Rocq.Corelib.Init.Nat.of_num_uint ds) =
    match NativeBridge.Incremental.numberUintTo ds with
    | Sum.inl xs => List.foldl (fun a d => 10 * a + ↑d) 0 xs
    | Sum.inr xs => List.foldl (fun a d => 16 * a + ↑d) 0 xs
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.number_read_agrees

type:
∀ (ds : Rocq.Corelib.Init.Hexadecimal.uint) (acc : NativeBridge.MN),
  NativeBridge.natTo (Rocq.Corelib.Init.Nat.of_hex_uint_acc ds acc) =
    List.foldl (fun a d => 16 * a + ↑d) (NativeBridge.natTo acc) (NativeBridge.hexadecimalDigitsTo ds)
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.hexadecimal_read_acc_agrees

type:
¬∀ (x y : Rocq.Corelib.Init.Hexadecimal.uint),
    Rocq.Corelib.Init.Nat.of_hex_uint x = Rocq.Corelib.Init.Nat.of_hex_uint y → x = y
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.hexadecimal_decode_not_injective

type:
∀ (ds : Rocq.Corelib.Init.Decimal.uint),
  NativeBridge.natTo (Rocq.Corelib.Init.Nat.of_uint ds) =
    List.foldl (fun a d => 10 * a + ↑d) 0 (NativeBridge.decimalDigitsTo ds)
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.decimal_read_agrees

type:
∀ (ds : Rocq.Corelib.Init.Decimal.uint) (acc : NativeBridge.MN),
  NativeBridge.natTo (Rocq.Corelib.Init.Nat.of_uint_acc ds acc) =
    List.foldl (fun a d => 10 * a + ↑d) (NativeBridge.natTo acc) (NativeBridge.decimalDigitsTo ds)
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.decimal_read_acc_agrees

type:
(motive : List (Fin 10) ⊕ List (Fin 16) → Sort u_1) →
  (x : List (Fin 10) ⊕ List (Fin 16)) →
    ((ds : List (Fin 10)) → motive (Sum.inl ds)) → ((ds : List (Fin 16)) → motive (Sum.inr ds)) → motive x
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.numberUintOf.match_1

type: ¬∀ (x y : Rocq.Corelib.Init.Decimal.uint), Rocq.Corelib.Init.Nat.of_uint x = Rocq.Corelib.Init.Nat.of_uint y → x = y
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.decimal_decode_not_injective

type:
∀ (ds : Rocq.Corelib.Init.Hexadecimal.uint),
  NativeBridge.natTo (Rocq.Corelib.Init.Nat.of_hex_uint ds) =
    List.foldl (fun a d => 16 * a + ↑d) 0 (NativeBridge.hexadecimalDigitsTo ds)
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.hexadecimal_read_agrees
